ems.sub: One smart system that runs your battery, EV chargers and solar as a single whole. We write the strategy that fits your hotel, not a fixed profile someone else designed.
ems.wat-h2: The brain behind your energy system
ems.wat-p: An Energy Management System (EMS) is the software that smartly distributes all your energy: when to charge, when to store, when to use. It makes sure you never draw more power from the grid than needed, that you avoid peak-demand penalties and that you make the most of your solar power.
ems.s1p: Keep the grid connection at zero: discharge on import, charge on export. The standard strategy that makes your hotel more energy independent.
ems.s2p: Stay within your configured power limit, so you never exceed your contracted capacity and avoid high penalties.
ems.s3p: Use the solar power you generate as much as possible directly yourself, instead of feeding it back to an increasingly unfavourable grid.
ems.s4p: Charge when power is cheap and discharge when power is expensive, so your hotel benefits from low rates.
ems.s5p: Reserve battery capacity for active EV-charging demand, so guests can always charge exactly when needed.
ems.s6p: Demand response, or a strategy only your hotel needs. From the breakfast rush to the event room: we tailor the system to your operation.
ems.diff-h2: This is how our EMS differs from an off-the-shelf system
ems.diff-p: Many off-the-shelf EMS solutions work with pre-configured profiles you can only select from. We program the strategy to fit your site, so the system adapts to your operation.
ems.d1p: We write the strategy your operation needs, instead of a choice from fixed profiles. Delivered within days by our own engineering team.
ems.d3p: Battery, EV chargers and solar run on one system via OCPP 2.0.1 and a single driver layer. No separate charging back-office or patchwork of systems.
ems.d4p: We read and control every parameter of our own hardware: battery per cell, inverter and charger.
ems.d5p: From a budget calculator to an independent monitor (Guardian) with its own meter: the system fails safe and keeps running reliably.
ems.d6p: Full operation on site, even during an outage or without our cloud services. Your hotel keeps running smoothly and safely.
ems.ctah: Ready to have your energy managed smartly?

ems.ins-h2: Everything clear, control whenever you want
ems.i1h: All your data in one place
ems.i1p: See in one dashboard what your system does: live status, generation, consumption, charging and your savings. No separate portals or systems side by side.
ems.i2h: Adjust your strategy when you want
ems.i2p: Change your strategy at the moment you want, per site and audited. If your operation moves in another direction, your EMS moves with you.
ems.i3p: See what each part delivers: battery, charging and solar. Monthly reports and history, so you know the numbers behind your choices.
